weights.checksum_note: MD5 and byte lengths are the publication's integrity metadata; they are not cryptographic signatures. The combined SHA-256 was independently computed after an HTTPS download matched the published size and MD5. The loader requires the pinned SHA-256 as well as published size/MD5 before deserialization. Split loading remains disabled until a verified SHA-256 is pinned.
weights.semantics: These singing-aware checkpoints are distinct from ordinary DnR v3 weights. Combined music includes singing; split music_vocals is separate from speech.
weights.validation: The combined checkpoint download matched the published byte length and MD5, and its independently computed SHA-256 is pinned. The verified combined checkpoint loaded strictly into this constructor on CPU using Torch 2.8.0 (37,022,688 parameters). GPU inference and listening quality remain to be evaluated on the target machine.
